ex.en: A new bridge now links the remote island to the mainland.
ex.zh: 现在有一座新大桥把这个偏远岛屿与大陆连接起来。

mainly.usage: adv.主要地，首要地；大部分， 大多

ex.en: The company's profits come mainly from its overseas operations rather than domestic sales.
ex.zh: 该公司的利润主要来自海外业务，而非国内销售。

senses: v. 维持；维修；坚持认为
maintain.usage: v.维持；维修，保养；断言，主 张；赡养，抚养；v.维持；维修，保养；断言， 主张；抚养；发音类似“埋汰”→这车太埋汰了，需要维修保养了→维修；维持。派生：maintenance；联想记忆:main(主要的)+tain(hold,抓)→紧抓主要观点→坚称;①保持例2020年完形,②坚称例2016年阅读,③养护例2011

ex.en: The best way to maintain good blood circulation is through using the brain.
ex.zh: 保持良好血液循环的最佳方法是使用大脑。

ex.en: Sometimes, parents get exhausted and are unable to maintain a tolerant style with their kids.
ex.zh: 有时，父母们会感到精疲力竭，无法对自己的孩子保持宽容的态度。

ex.en: It costs a lot of money to maintain an old house in good condition.
ex.zh: 要让一座老房子保持良好状态要花很多钱。

senses: n. ①(状态、进程等的)维持，保持(u)
②(建筑物、机器、道路等的)维修，保养(u)
③(依法应负担的)生活费，赡养费(u)
n. 维护；保养；维持，保持

phrases.p: the cost of repairs and maintenance

maintenance.usage: 记：main(留)+ten(握)+-ance(名后缀)→握住状态的停留→保持；[族]maintain vt.维持保持；[近]preservation n.维持；n.维护，保养；维持；抚养费；maintain 的派生词；索引p411

ex.en: Yes, more investment is needed, but passengers will not be willing to pay more indefinitely if they must also endure cramped, unreliable services, interrupted by regular chaos when timetables are changed, or planned maintenance is managed incompetently.
ex.zh: 是的，（铁路）还需要更多的投资，但如果乘客还必须忍受出行拥挤、忍受不可靠的服务、忍受常由时刻表更改或常规性维护管理不当而带来的混乱，那么他们就不会愿意无限期地支付更多。

ex.en: Regular maintenance of equipment can prevent costly breakdowns on the production line.
ex.zh: 设备的定期维护可以避免生产线上代价高昂的故障。

ex.en: the maintenance of life
ex.zh: 生命的维持

senses: n. 最高权威,王权；雄伟
majesty.usage: 派生majestic adj.威严的；壮丽的;majestically adv.威严地

ex.en: Visitors stood in silence before the majesty of the snow-capped peaks.
ex.zh: 游客们静默地伫立在雄伟的雪峰面前。

senses: n. [C] 少校；专业课；主修生
n. ①专业，主修科(c)②专业学生(c)③少校(c)

ex.en: Fossil fuels remain the major source of primary energy consumption in today's world.
ex.zh: 化石燃料仍然是当今世界能源消费的主要来源。

ex.en: These are disciplines that are going out of style: 22% of American college graduates now major in business compared with only 2% in history and 4% in English.
ex.zh: 这些学科正日趋过时：现在美国22%的大学毕业生主修商业，但相比之下，只有2%主修历史，4%主修英语。

ex.en: She decided to major in economics because it offers wide career choices.
ex.zh: 她决定主修经济学，因为它提供了广泛的职业选择。

senses: n. ①多数，大多数；半数以上
majority.usage: n.大多数，大部分 adj.多数人的；索引p412

ex.en: In the nursing profession, women are in the majority.
ex.zh: 在护理行业，女性占大多数。

ex.en: Like the majority of authors, he had to suffer many disappointments and rejections along the way, but these made him all the more determined to succeed.
ex.zh: 和大多数作家一样，一路走来，他（指詹姆斯·赫里奥特）必须经历许许多多的失望和被拒绝，但是这些让他更加下定决心要成功。

ex.en: The majority of respondents supported the plan, though a few strongly opposed it.
ex.zh: 大多数受访者支持该计划，尽管少数人强烈反对。

senses: vt. 制造；做；组装；制定；使出现
③强迫，迫使(made him clean up)
make.usage: 辨析:make普通用语，含手工机器制造及艺术科学创造；manufacture多指机器大规模生产；produce强调数量及品种

ex.en: Cheap imports make it increasingly hard for local firms to compete on price.
ex.zh: 廉价的进口商品使当地企业在价格上越来越难以竞争。

ex.en: She worked overtime throughout the month to make up for the time lost during her illness.
ex.zh: 她整月都在加班，以弥补生病期间耽误的时间。

senses: adj. 权宜的,临时代用的

ex.en: After the earthquake, survivors sheltered in makeshift tents built from plastic sheets and wooden poles.
ex.zh: 地震过后，幸存者们栖身于用塑料布和木杆搭成的临时帐篷里。

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

ex.en: Malaysia has become a major centre for electronics manufacturing in Southeast Asia over the past two decades.
ex.zh: 过去二十年里，马来西亚已成为东南亚电子制造业的重要中心。

ex.en: The study found no significant difference between male and female applicants.
ex.zh: 研究发现男性和女性申请者之间没有显著差异。

ex.en: The report notes that women remain under-represented in the male-dominated construction industry.
ex.zh: 报告指出，在男性主导的建筑业中，女性所占比例仍然偏低。

senses: adj. (指人或人的行为)恶毒的,恶意的
adj. (指肿瘤、疾病)恶性的,致命的
malignant.usage: 派生malignancy n.恶毒,恶意,恶性

ex.en: Doctors confirmed that the tumour was malignant and required immediate treatment.
ex.zh: 医生确认肿瘤是恶性的，需要立即治疗。

senses: n. 玩忽职守；不法行为
n. (专业人员的)渎职,玩忽职守
malpractice.usage: n.玩忽职守，营私舞弊；渎职；索引p412

ex.en: The surgeon was sued for malpractice after leaving an instrument inside the patient.
ex.zh: 这名外科医生因把器械遗留在病人体内而被起诉渎职。

ex.en: Insurance against medical malpractice now consumes a large share of doctors' incomes.
ex.zh: 医疗渎职保险如今占去了医生收入的很大一部分。

ex.en: Auditors uncovered financial malpractice at the heart of the charity.
ex.zh: 审计人员揭露了这家慈善机构核心层的财务违规行为。

ex.en: The blue whale is the largest mammal on earth.
ex.zh: 蓝鲸是地球上最大的哺乳动物。

ex.en: Unlike reptiles, mammals maintain a constant body temperature.
ex.zh: 与爬行动物不同，哺乳动物能保持恒定的体温。

ex.en: Fossil evidence suggests early mammals were mostly small, night-active creatures.
ex.zh: 化石证据表明，早期哺乳动物大多是小型的夜间活动动物。

senses: n. 丈夫；男人；人类；士兵

ex.en: Early man migrated across continents in constant search of food and shelter.
ex.zh: 早期人类为不断寻找食物和庇护所在各大洲间迁徙。

ex.en: Critics argue that man-made climate change demands immediate international cooperation.
ex.zh: 批评人士认为，人为造成的气候变化需要立即开展国际合作。

senses: v. 管理，负责；完成（困难的事）；勉力完成
manage.usage: 派生management n.经营；manager n.经营者，经理；manageable adj.可操纵的；索引p412

ex.en: They can manage to have a job in one place and a family in another.
ex.zh: 他们可以在一个地方谋职，在另一个地方安家。

ex.en: Try to slot it as a to-do list item and you'll manage only goal-focused reading—useful, sometimes, but not the most fulfilling kind.
ex.zh: 如果竭力将其（指阅读）加入必做清单，你就只会做目标式阅读——有时候这是有用的，但这并非是最让人满意的阅读方式。

ex.en: Somehow she managed to finish the thesis while working full time.
ex.zh: 她不知怎么地在全职工作的同时完成了论文。

ex.en: The airline managed to rebook all stranded passengers within a day.
ex.zh: 航空公司设法在一天之内为所有滞留乘客重新订好机票。

senses: adj. 可操纵的；可处理的

ex.en: By dividing the project into smaller tasks, the team made the workload far more manageable.
ex.zh: 通过把项目拆分成更小的任务，团队使工作量变得容易掌控得多。

management.usage: n.经营，管理，安排；管理层；另:time-management technique时间管理技巧；索引p412

ex.en: Effective management of time matters more to students than raw intelligence.
ex.zh: 对学生来说，有效的时间管理比单纯的智力更重要。

ex.en: Talks between the union and management broke down over pay.
ex.zh: 工会与管理层的谈判因薪酬问题破裂。

ex.en: The company's management style encourages staff to propose ideas openly.
ex.zh: 该公司的管理风格鼓励员工公开提出想法。

manager.usage: n.经理；经纪人；管理人，主 教练

ex.en: The branch manager is responsible for meeting monthly sales targets.
ex.zh: 分行经理负责完成月度销售指标。

ex.en: A good manager listens before making decisions that affect the whole team.
ex.zh: 优秀的经理在做出影响整个团队的决定之前会先倾听。

ex.en: She was promoted from assistant to manager within two years.
ex.zh: 她在两年内从助理晋升为经理。

senses: v. 强制执行；委托办理；授权
n. 授权；委托书；授权令

ex.en: The United Nations mandate authorises peacekeeping forces in the region.
ex.zh: 联合国的授权批准在该地区部署维和部队。

ex.en: Critics say the agency acted beyond its legal mandate.
ex.zh: 批评者称该机构的行为超出了其法定授权范围。

ex.en: New rules mandate that all public buildings meet strict energy standards.
ex.zh: 新规定强制要求所有公共建筑达到严格的能源标准。

ex.en: Regular safety training is mandatory for all workers operating heavy machinery in the factory.
ex.zh: 对工厂里所有操作重型机械的工人来说，定期安全培训是强制性的。

senses: adj. 明显的，显而易见的
manifest.usage: [近] obvious a. 明显的；ma(骂)+ni(你)+fest(发音似"烦死他")→骂你→显而易见的；辨析：manifest 书面正式用词，指明确地表明；索引p412

ex.en: His nervousness was manifest to all those present.
ex.zh: 所有在场的人都看出了他很紧张。

ex.en: Bottled water, chewing gum and skin moisturizers are mentioned in Paragraph 5 so as to manifest the significant role of good habits.
ex.zh: 第5段提及瓶装水、口香糖和保湿霜是为了表明好习惯的重要作用。

ex.en: Stress often manifests itself in physical symptoms such as headaches and sleeplessness.
ex.zh: 压力常常表现为头痛和失眠等身体症状。

ex.en: The protests were widely seen as a manifestation of deep public frustration.
ex.zh: 抗议活动被普遍视为公众深度不满的一种表现。

ex.en: The party's manifesto promises major investment in public transport networks.
ex.zh: 该党的宣言承诺对公共交通网络进行大规模投资。

senses: ③(尤指用权势或不正当手段)操纵，控制
manipulate.usage: man（手）+ipul（拉）+-ate→用手拉线控制木偶→操纵。族manipulation n.操纵；manipulative a.操控的；同义 handle，operate，manage；名词 manipulation（操作，操纵）。表示出现显露时须接反身代词，in 后接表现的方面；man（人）+i+pul（联想成p

ex.en: As a politician, he knows how to manipulate public opinion.
ex.zh: 身为政客，他知道如何左右公众舆论。

ex.en: Advertisers sometimes manipulate consumers by exploiting their fear of missing out.
ex.zh: 广告商有时会利用消费者害怕错过的心理来操纵他们。

ex.en: The scientist can manipulate tiny objects with great precision using special tools.
ex.zh: 这位科学家能用特殊工具非常精确地操作微小物体。

ex.en: The senator accused the media of the deliberate manipulation of public opinion during the election.
ex.zh: 这位参议员指责媒体在选举期间蓄意操纵舆论。

mankind.usage: 辨析:mankind泛指古今中外甚至未来的人,常含崇高庄重正式色彩;man普通用语,可指具体的人尤指男人

ex.en: Climate change poses a serious and growing threat to all mankind.
ex.zh: 气候变化对全人类构成日益严重的威胁。

senses: n. 方法，方式；举止；礼貌；礼仪

ex.en: These children need to learn some manners.
ex.zh: 这些孩子需要学习一些礼仪。

ex.en: She greeted each guest in a warm and friendly manner.
ex.zh: 她以热情友好的方式迎接每一位客人。

ex.en: He has an aggressive manner that makes people uneasy.
ex.zh: 他举止咄咄逼人，让人感到不安。

senses: v. 用策略,调动,(敏捷地)操纵
manoeuvre.usage: 亦拼作maneuver;派生manoeuvrable adj.可移动的

ex.en: The government manoeuvred its chief critics out of the key parliamentary committees.
ex.zh: 政府运用策略把其主要批评者排挤出关键的议会委员会。

ex.en: The factory introduced new machines to reduce its dependence on costly manpower.
ex.zh: 这家工厂引进新机器，以减少对昂贵人力的依赖。

ex.en: The Victorian mansion has been converted into a museum that is open to the public.
ex.zh: 这座维多利亚时代的大厦已被改造成向公众开放的博物馆。

ex.en: The Latin root manu, meaning hand, appears in words such as manual, manufacture and manuscript.
ex.zh: 拉丁词根 manu 意为“手”，出现在 manual、manufacture 和 manuscript 等词中。

senses: adj. 手的,手工做的,体力的
adj. 手动的；手工的；体力的
manual.usage: manu(hand手)+al→手的,手工的；manu（手）+al（形容词后缀）→用手做的→手动的，手工的→手册，指南；索引p412

ex.en: The computer comes with a 600-page instruction manual.
ex.zh: 电脑附有一本600页的使用指南。

ex.en: Even in the digital age, many craftsmen still prefer manual tools.
ex.zh: 即使在数字时代，许多工匠仍然偏爱手工工具。

ex.en: The service manual explains how to replace the filter in a few simple steps.
ex.zh: 维修手册用几个简单步骤说明了如何更换滤芯。

ex.en: Workers in the ports fear that automation will replace manual labour.
ex.zh: 港口工人担心自动化会取代体力劳动。

senses: v. （用机器）大量生产，成批制造；捏造，编造
n. 大量制造；批量生产；工业品
manufacture.usage: manu(手)+facture(制造)→制造；v.生产，制造；生成 n.大量制造，商品；词根记忆:manu(hand,手工的)+fact(make,制作)+ure→手工制作→大量生产；索引p412

ex.en: The evidence against him had been largely manufactured.
ex.zh: 对他不利的证据大部分是伪造的。

ex.en: He points out that the U.S. doesn't manufacture anything anymore.
ex.zh: 他指出，美国不再大量生产任何货品。

ex.en: The factory can manufacture thousands of smartphones every day to meet growing demand.
ex.zh: 这家工厂每天能制造数千部智能手机以满足不断增长的需求。

ex.en: Either way, one benefit of a "national" organization would be to negotiate better prices, if possible, with drug manufacturers.
ex.zh: 无论哪种方式，一个全国性组织的好处是，如果可能的话，与药品制造商谈判更优惠的价格。

ex.en: The car manufacturer recalled thousands of vehicles because of a faulty brake switch.
ex.zh: 这家汽车制造商因制动开关存在缺陷召回了数千辆汽车。

ex.en: Toy manufacturers must meet strict safety standards before their products reach the shops.
ex.zh: 玩具制造商的产品上市前必须符合严格的安全标准。

ex.en: Manufacturing output rose by three percent last quarter, signalling a modest recovery in the industrial sector.
ex.zh: 上季度制造业产出增长了百分之三，表明工业部门正温和复苏。

manuscript.usage: manu(手)+script(写)→手写的→手稿；n.手稿，原稿；手抄本；manu（手，人工）+script（写）→手写的东西→手稿，原稿；词根记忆：manu(hand，手)+script(write，写)→手稿；索引p412

ex.en: I read her poems in manuscript.
ex.zh: 我读过她的诗作的手稿。

ex.en: The author spent three years revising the manuscript before sending it to publishers.
ex.zh: 作者花了三年时间修改手稿，然后才寄给出版商。

ex.en: Researchers discovered an ancient manuscript that had been hidden in the monastery for centuries.
ex.zh: 研究人员发现了一部在修道院里藏了几百年的古代手稿。

ex.en: Many of the original manuscripts were tragically destroyed in the great fire.
ex.zh: 许多原始手稿在那场大火中不幸被毁。

ex.en: The researchers mapped the distribution of the rare species across the whole region.
ex.zh: 研究人员绘制了该珍稀物种在整个地区的分布图。

ex.en: The maple leaves turn brilliant red before falling in late autumn.
ex.zh: 枫叶在深秋飘落之前会变成绚丽的红色。

ex.en: The survey results, collected in Mar, show a sharp rise in consumer confidence.
ex.zh: 三月收集的调查结果显示消费者信心大幅上升。

senses: n. 马拉松赛跑;马拉松式的活动(或工作)

ex.en: Running a full marathon demands months of disciplined training rather than raw talent alone.
ex.zh: 跑完全程马拉松需要数月有规律的训练，而不仅仅靠天赋。

ex.en: The museum's entrance hall was paved with polished marble imported from Italy.
ex.zh: 博物馆的门厅铺着从意大利进口的抛光大理石。

senses: v. 把……带走,迫使……到(某处)

ex.en: Thousands of protesters marched through the capital to demand stricter environmental laws.
ex.zh: 数千名抗议者游行穿过首都，要求制定更严格的环境法律。

ex.en: The root marg comes from a Latin word meaning border, as seen in margin and marginal.
ex.zh: 词根 marg 源自拉丁语，意为“边界”，见于 margin 和 marginal 等词。

senses: n. 边缘部分；非主体部分
n. 页边空白；边缘；幅度
margin.usage: n.页边空白；差额；利润；余地；mar(联想成Mar"火星")+gin(发音类似"进")→进入火星，肯定从火星的"边缘"进→边缘；词根记忆：marg(mark,记号)+in→能做标记的地方→页边空白。；索引p412

ex.en: The company relies on fat margins from luxury models.
ex.zh: 公司靠豪华车赚取丰厚利润。

ex.en: Not the 20% profit margins that were routine a few years ago, but profit all the same.
ex.zh: 虽然不再是几年前惯常的20%的利润率，但还是盈利了的。

ex.en: The airline cut costs to widen its profit margin in a fiercely competitive market.
ex.zh: 这家航空公司削减成本，以在竞争激烈的市场中扩大利润率。

senses: adj. 记在页边的，边缘的
adj. 小的；微不足道的；不重要的
adj. 不重要的；边缘的；页边的
marginal.usage: adj.小的，微不足道的；边缘的； 页边的；索引p412

ex.en: The other alternatives are attractive in theory but in practice are either impractical or offer only marginal improvements.
ex.zh: 其他替代方案在理论上有吸引力，但在实践中要么不切实际，要么只是提供了微小的改进。

ex.en: The new policy has only a marginal effect on the unemployment rate.
ex.zh: 新政策对失业率只有微乎其微的影响。

ex.en: He made marginal notes in the book while reading it late at night.
ex.zh: 他深夜读书时在页边做了批注。

senses: v. 使显得微不足道;使处于边缘;使无实权

ex.en: The scheme was criticised for tending to marginalize elderly workers in favour of younger recruits.
ex.zh: 该计划因在招聘中偏重年轻人、使老年工人边缘化而受到批评。

senses: adj. 海的，海生的；海事的
marine.usage: adj.海洋的，海产的；海运的 n.海军陆战队士兵

ex.en: Plastic waste poses a serious threat to marine life.
ex.zh: 塑料垃圾对海洋生物构成严重威胁。

ex.en: The marine climate keeps the island mild and humid all year.
ex.zh: 海洋性气候使该岛全年温和湿润。

ex.en: He served as a marine for eight years before joining the police.
ex.zh: 他当了八年海军陆战队士兵，之后加入了警队。

senses: adj. 婚姻的;夫妻关系的
adj. 婚姻的；夫妻关系的
marital.usage: marit（联想成marry“结婚”）+al（后缀）→婚姻的。；索引p412

ex.en: A female client had marital difficulties.
ex.zh: 一名女性客户有婚姻问题。

ex.en: Recent surveys show that financial stress is a leading cause of marital problems among young couples.
ex.zh: 近期调查显示，经济压力是年轻夫妇婚姻问题的主要诱因。

ex.en: The counselor suggested that honest communication could ease many marital conflicts.
ex.zh: 咨询师建议，坦诚的沟通可以缓解许多婚姻矛盾。

senses: vt.&vi. 留下痕迹；使有污点
mark.usage: n.标志，迹象；记号；痕迹， 污点；分数 v.做标记；评分；留下痕迹， 使有污点；标明；标志；索引p412

ex.en: Last year marked the third year in a row that Indonesia's bleak rate of deforestation has slowed in pace.
ex.zh: 去年是印度尼西亚森林砍伐率连续第三年放缓。

ex.en: Teachers mark the essays according to clearly defined criteria rather than personal impressions.
ex.zh: 教师依据明确规定的标准而非个人印象来给作文打分。

ex.en: The boundary stones mark the edge of the land belonging to the village.
ex.zh: 这些界石标出属于该村土地的边缘。

ex.en: In the 1960s and 1970s, European universities saw marked changes in their governance arrangements, with the empowerment of junior faculty and to some degree of students as well.
ex.zh: 在20世纪60年代和70年代，欧洲大学的管理安排发生了显著变化，开始放权给初级教员，在一定程度上，也给予学生一些权力。

senses: adv. 引人注目地,显著地

phrases.p: a markedly different, more vibrant organization
phrases.m: 一个明显不同的、更加有活力的组织

ex.en: Students' reading speeds improved markedly after they adopted the new skimming techniques.
ex.zh: 学生们采用新的略读技巧后，阅读速度显著提高。

ex.en: The company hopes to expand into the fast-growing Chinese market.
ex.zh: 该公司希望拓展到快速增长的中国市场。

ex.en: Farmers bring their fresh produce to the weekly market.
ex.zh: 农民们每周把新鲜农产品带到集市上出售。

ex.en: The firm spends millions marketing its products to teenagers.
ex.zh: 该公司斥资数百万向青少年推销其产品。

market value.usage: / 市场价值 / / 上市公司

ex.en: Shares fell sharply when the firm's market value dropped by a fifth within a single week.
ex.zh: 该公司市值在一周之内缩水五分之一，股价随之大幅下跌。

ex.en: A skilled marketer understands that consumer trust is far harder to build than brand awareness.
ex.zh: 高明的营销人员深谙，建立消费者信任远比打造品牌知名度困难。

ex.en: Some AI software can analyze and optimize marketing email subject lines to increase open rates.
ex.zh: 一些人工智能软件可以分析和优化营销电子邮件的主题栏，提高邮件打开率。

senses: n. 市场,集市;市场竞争,商业(活动)

ex.en: Online marketplaces have transformed the way small businesses reach customers across the globe.
ex.zh: 在线市场改变了小企业触达全球客户的方式。

ex.en: The antique desk is decorated with fine marquetry depicting birds and flowers.
ex.zh: 这张古董书桌饰有描绘花鸟的精美镶嵌细工。

ex.en: Husband and wife have different expectations from their marriage.
ex.zh: 夫妻双方对婚姻有着不同的期望。

ex.en: Their marriage lasted only two years before they divorced.
ex.zh: 他们的婚姻只维持了两年便以离婚告终。

ex.en: The survey examines how money worries affect marriage.
ex.zh: 这项调查研究了经济上的忧虑如何影响婚姻。

senses: a. 已婚的；婚姻的；结婚的

ex.en: The survey found that married employees reported higher job satisfaction than single ones.
ex.zh: 调查发现，已婚员工报告的工作满意度高于单身员工。

ex.en: They married in a small ceremony attended only by close family.
ex.zh: 他们在一场只有至亲参加的小型仪式上结了婚。

ex.en: She married her college sweetheart soon after graduation.
ex.zh: 毕业后不久，她与大学时的恋人结了婚。

ex.en: The official married the couple in the town hall.
ex.zh: 这位官员在市政厅为这对新人主持了婚礼。

ex.en: Thousands of migratory birds stop at the coastal marsh each spring to rest and feed.
ex.zh: 每年春天，成千上万的候鸟在这片沿海湿地停留休息、觅食。

senses: n. 元帅;典礼官;执法官;消防局长,警察局长

ex.en: The general marshalled his forces along the northern border before the offensive began.
ex.zh: 进攻开始之前，将军在北部边境集结了他的部队。

ex.en: The government declared martial law after riots broke out in the capital.
ex.zh: 首都发生骚乱后，政府宣布实行戒严。

ex.en: Historians debate whether the reformer should be honoured as a martyr or remembered simply as a politician.
ex.zh: 历史学家对这位改革者应被尊为殉道者还是仅作为政治家来纪念存在争论。

senses: v. 感到惊奇；大为赞叹
n. 令人惊异的人(或事)

ex.en: To read such books today is to marvel at the fact that their learned contents were once deemed suitable for publication in general circulation dailies.
ex.zh: 今天读到这样的书，你会惊讶于这样一个事实：书里的学术内容曾经被认为适合发表在面向普通读者发行的日报上。

ex.en: To read such books today is to marvel at the fact that their learned contents were once deemed suitable for publication in general-circulation dailies.
ex.zh: 如果今天再来读这些书籍的话，就会不禁惊诧于这样的事实：这些学术性的内容竟然曾被认为适合刊登在面向大众发行的日报上。

ex.en: Tourists marvel at the cathedral's soaring arches and stained glass.
ex.zh: 游客们惊叹于大教堂高耸的拱门和彩色玻璃。

ex.en: The museum's marvellous collection of ancient coins attracts scholars from around the world.
ex.zh: 博物馆里了不起的古钱币藏品吸引了世界各地的学者。

ex.en: This will be a marvellous opportunity for her.
ex.zh: 这对她可是千载难逢的机会。

senses: adj. 惊人的,奇迹般的,奇妙的

ex.en: The device has a marvelous capacity to store data without any external power supply.
ex.zh: 该装置具有无需外部电源即可存储数据的惊人能力。

ex.en: The seminar examined how Marxist theory interpreted the relationship between labour and capital.
ex.zh: 研讨会考察了马克思主义理论如何解释劳动与资本之间的关系。

senses: a. 男性的；男子气概的
adj. 男性的；男子气概的
adj. 男子气概的；阳性的
masculine.usage: 反feminine a.女性的。语法中masculine阳性/feminine阴性/neuter中性；索引p412

ex.en: In many languages, every noun is classified as masculine, feminine or neutral.
ex.zh: 在许多语言中，每个名词都被归为阳性、阴性或中性。

ex.en: The adverts promoted a narrow, old-fashioned image of masculine strength.
ex.zh: 这些广告宣传了一种狭隘而过时的男性力量形象。

ex.en: Society increasingly accepts men who reject traditional masculine roles.
ex.zh: 社会越来越接受拒绝传统男性角色的男性。

ex.en: Boil the potatoes until soft, then mash them with a little butter and milk.
ex.zh: 把土豆煮软，然后加少许黄油和牛奶捣成泥。

ex.en: Mies's sophisticated presentation masked the fact that the spaces he designed were small and efficient, rather than big and often empty.
ex.zh: 密斯复杂的展示方式掩盖了这样一个事实：他设计的空间是小而高效的，而不是大而空旷的。

ex.en: Doctors and nurses wore masks to protect themselves from infection.
ex.zh: 医生和护士戴着口罩以防感染。

ex.en: His cheerful smile masked deep anxiety about losing his job.
ex.zh: 他开朗的笑容掩盖着对失去工作的深深忧虑。

senses: n. 大量；许多；团；块；群众，平民百姓
adj. 大批的；数量极多的；广泛的
mass.usage: n.团，块；大量；质量 adj.大量的 v.聚集，集结；②n.[pl.]群众(2017年完形)例:A few wealthy people will own all the capital, and the masses will struggle in an impoverished wasteland.少数富人将拥

ex.en: And history should be the story of the masses.
ex.zh: 因而历史应该是人民大众的历史。

ex.en: Whenever decisions are based on masses of data, "you quickly get into a lot of ethical questions," notes Tan Kiat How.
ex.zh: 只要是决策需要依据大量的数据时，"你很快会遇到很多道德问题"，陈杰豪这样说。

ex.en: Social media allows a mass of users to share information within seconds.
ex.zh: 社交媒体使大量用户能够在几秒钟内分享信息。

senses: a. 面向大众的；适销对路的

ex.en: The publisher aims to cut prices for its mass-market paperbacks to attract younger readers.
ex.zh: 这家出版社打算下调大众市场平装书的价格，以吸引年轻读者。

senses: n. 大屠杀；(比赛中的)惨败

ex.en: The museum was built in memory of the victims of the wartime massacre.
ex.zh: 这座博物馆是为纪念战时大屠杀的受难者而建的。

ex.en: Historians have debated for decades about the true causes of the massacre.
ex.zh: 几十年来，历史学家一直在争论这场大屠杀的真正原因。

ex.en: Their 0-5 defeat was described by the press as a complete massacre.
ex.zh: 他们0比5的惨败被媒体称为一场彻底的溃败。

senses: adj. ①大而重的，厚实的，粗大的
adj. 大量的，巨大的；严重的；大而重的；结实的
adj. （尺寸、数量、规模）非常大的；非常严重的

ex.en: This massive investment could change the picture rapidly in coming years.
ex.zh: 这项大规模投资可能会在未来几年迅速改变局面。

ex.en: The bridge collapsed because the flood placed massive pressure on its supports.
ex.zh: 洪水对桥墩施加了巨大压力，导致桥梁倒塌。

ex.en: The government launched a massive campaign to encourage citizens to get vaccinated.
ex.zh: 政府发起了一场大规模的运动，鼓励市民接种疫苗。

senses: n. 师傅,能手,大家,大师
vt. 精通,掌握;adj. 熟练的
n. 大师；主人；硕士(学位)

ex.en: Retailers that master the intricacies of wholesaling in Europe may well expect to rake in substantial profits thereby.
ex.zh: 掌握着欧洲批发行业复杂流程的零售商们完全可以赚到丰厚的利润。

ex.en: She mastered the basics of French within six months.
ex.zh: 她在六个月内掌握了法语的基础知识。

ex.en: The painting is attributed to a master of the Italian Renaissance.
ex.zh: 这幅画被认为是意大利文艺复兴时期一位大师的作品。

masterpiece.usage: [记] master（大师）+piece（作品）→大师杰出的作品→杰作；索引p412

ex.en: The cathedral is regarded as a masterpiece of Gothic architecture.
ex.zh: 这座大教堂被视为哥特式建筑的杰作。

ex.en: The novelist spent ten years writing her masterpiece.
ex.zh: 这位小说家花了十年时间创作她的代表作。

ex.en: Critics hailed the film as an early masterpiece of silent cinema.
ex.zh: 影评人称赞这部电影是默片时代的早期杰作。

senses: adj. (matt,matte) 无光泽的,不光亮的,亚光的

ex.en: Please wipe your shoes on the mat before entering the laboratory.
ex.zh: 进实验室前请先在垫子上擦净鞋底。

phrases.m: 在某方面与某人是对手

ex.en: No other candidate could match her combination of technical skill and leadership.
ex.zh: 没有其他候选人能在技术能力与领导力的结合上与她匹敌。

senses: n. 媒人,牵线搭桥的人,红娘

ex.en: In the novel, a well-meaning matchmaker's plans repeatedly go hilariously wrong.
ex.zh: 小说中，一位好心的媒人的种种计划一再闹出滑稽的乱子。

ex.en: Penguins usually mate for life, returning to the same partner every breeding season.
ex.zh: 企鹅通常终身只有一个配偶，每个繁殖季都回到同一伴侣身边。

material.usage: n.布料；材料；素材 adj.物质的

ex.en: Recycled materials are increasingly used in packaging and construction.
ex.zh: 再生材料越来越多地用于包装和建筑领域。

ex.en: The report is essential source material for anyone studying education policy.
ex.zh: 这份报告是研究教育政策的人必不可少的第一手资料。

ex.en: Her parents could not afford the material comforts her classmates enjoyed.
ex.zh: 她的父母负担不起同学们所享受的物质舒适条件。

senses: n. 实利主义,物质主义;唯物论,唯物主义

ex.en: Critics argue that consumer culture encourages materialism at the expense of spiritual life.
ex.zh: 批评者认为，消费文化助长物质主义，牺牲了精神生活。

senses: adj. 实利主义的,物质主义的;唯物论的,唯物主义的

ex.en: Young people are often labelled materialistic, yet many of them volunteer for charity work.
ex.zh: 年轻人常被贴上物质主义的标签，但其中许多人仍志愿参加慈善工作。

senses: a. 母亲的；慈母般的；母系的
adj. 母亲的;母亲般的;母系的;母亲一方的
maternal.usage: adj.慈母般的；作为母亲的；母 系的

ex.en: Her maternal instincts made her a natural caregiver.
ex.zh: 她的母性本能使她天生擅长照顾他人。

ex.en: The child was raised by her maternal grandparents after the divorce.
ex.zh: 离婚后，这个孩子由外祖父母抚养长大。

ex.en: Maternal health has improved significantly over the past two decades.
ex.zh: 过去二十年，孕产妇健康状况有了显著改善。

maternity.usage: n.母性，母亲身份 adj.怀孕的，产妇的

ex.en: The company grants new mothers six months of paid maternity leave, well above the legal minimum.
ex.zh: 该公司给予新妈妈六个月带薪产假，远高于法定最低标准。

ex.en: The engineer used a simple mathematical model to predict the bridge's load capacity.
ex.zh: 工程师用一个简单的数学模型来预测这座桥的承载能力。

ex.en: A solid grounding in mathematics is essential for anyone studying physics or economics.
ex.zh: 扎实的数学基础对任何学习物理或经济学的人都必不可少。

matter.usage: 作动词“要紧”时常用于否定：It doesn't matter. 没关系。；n.事情，问题；事态；物质 v.要紧，有关系；辨析：指麻烦事只能用 matter（与定冠词连用）；男女间绯闻事件只能用 affair；表事务常用复数 affairs；索引p412

ex.en: What matters is that they will belong to a private monopoly which developed them using public resources.
ex.zh: 重要的是，它们（指这些算法）将属于利用公共资源开发的私人垄断企业。

ex.en: Money matters less than health when people reflect on what a good life means.
ex.zh: 当人们思考美好生活的意义时，金钱不如健康重要。

ex.en: The committee promised to look into the matter and report its findings within a month.
ex.zh: 委员会承诺调查此事，并在一个月内报告调查结果。

mature.usage: mature 指人或物发育方面的成熟;ripe 指水果、蔬菜等成熟或时机成熟；索引p412

ex.en: Children mature at different rates, both physically and emotionally.
ex.zh: 儿童在身体和情感上的成熟速度各不相同。

ex.en: She gave a calm, mature response to the harsh criticism.
ex.zh: 她对严厉的批评作出了冷静而成熟的回应。

ex.en: These trees take fifty years to mature fully.
ex.zh: 这些树需要五十年才能完全长成。

ex.en: Emotional maturity, rather than age, often determines how well a person handles criticism.
ex.zh: 决定一个人应对批评能力的往往是情感上的成熟，而非年龄。

ex.en: Athletes must balance training and rest to achieve maximal performance on race day.
ex.zh: 运动员必须平衡训练与休息，才能在比赛日达到最佳状态。

senses: （亦作maximize）vt. 使增加到最大限度；充分利用；最大限度地利用

ex.en: Most people try to maximise their gains and minimise their losses.
ex.zh: 大多数人都试图最大化他们的收益，最小化他们的损失。

senses: vt. 最大限度地利用；使增加到最大限度

phrases.p: maximize the role of landscape in human life
phrases.m: 将景观在人类生活中的作用最大化

ex.en: Retailers rearrange their stores to maximise the time shoppers spend browsing goods.
ex.zh: 零售商重新布置门店，以最大限度增加顾客浏览商品的时间。

senses: vt. 使最大化；充分利用

ex.en: Farmers can maximize crop yields by rotating planting schedules and improving soil quality.
ex.zh: 农民可以通过轮作安排和改良土壤来使农作物产量最大化。

ex.en: The airline redesigned its seating layout to maximise revenue on busy routes.
ex.zh: 该航空公司重新设计了座位布局，以在繁忙航线上实现收益最大化。

senses: adj. 最大的,最高的,最强的

ex.en: What is the absolute maximum you can afford to pay?
ex.zh: 你最多能出多少钱？

ex.en: That matters because theory suggests that the maximum sustainable yield that can be cropped from a fishery comes when the biomass of a target species is about 50% of its original levels.
ex.zh: 这很重要，因为理论表明，当目标物种的生物量约为其原始基数的50%时，渔场的可持续产量才能达到最高。

ex.en: The factory operates at maximum capacity during the holiday season to meet the surge in orders.
ex.zh: 假期期间工厂以最大产能运转，以满足订单激增的需求。

senses: modal v. 也许，可能；可以；但愿
aux. v. 可能,也许,可以

ex.en: Regular exercise may reduce the risk of heart disease, the researchers conclude.
ex.zh: 研究人员得出结论，经常锻炼可能降低患心脏病的风险。

senses: ad. （不确定）大概，可能；（提出建议）也许

ex.en: Maybe the company's sudden decision reflects pressure from its overseas investors.
ex.zh: 也许这家公司的突然决定反映了来自其海外投资者的压力。

ex.en: The mayor promised to expand public transport and cut traffic congestion downtown.
ex.zh: 市长承诺扩展公共交通，缓解市中心的交通拥堵。

ex.en: The mayoral election drew unusually high turnout, reflecting growing public interest in local politics.
ex.zh: 这次市长选举的投票率异常之高，反映出公众对地方政治的兴趣日益浓厚。

ex.en: The interviewer asked me why I wanted to pursue a graduate degree abroad.
ex.zh: 面试官问我为什么想出国攻读研究生学位。

senses: n. [C] 草地，（尤指）割草用的草地

ex.en: Beyond the village lies a wide meadow where cattle graze in summer.
ex.zh: 村子外面是一片宽阔的草地，夏天牛群在那里吃草。

ex.en: Nutritionists suggest eating a light meal at least two hours before exercise.
ex.zh: 营养学家建议在运动前至少两小时吃一顿清淡的饭。

senses: vt. 意思是；意思是说；打算；意味着
vt. 表示……的意思,意指;意欲,打算
adj. 卑鄙的;吝啬的,小气的

phrases.m: 对某人重要,对某人有价值
注定做某事；应该做某事

mean.usage: 拓展：the mean value 平均值；词组还有 mean well 本意是好的；by all means 当然可以；by no means 绝不；索引p412

ex.en: The word 'Caravanserai' is a combination of the Persian words 'kárván', which means a group of travellers or a caravan, and 'saráy', a palace or enclosed building.
ex.zh: "Caravanserai"这个词是由波斯语"kárván"(指一群旅行者或商队)和"saráy"(指宫殿或封闭式建筑)组合而成。

ex.en: The flashing light means (that) you must stop.
ex.zh: 闪烁的灯光表示你必须停下。

ex.en: He wanted viewers to walk around on the carpets—which meant they had to be durable.
ex.zh: 他希望观众可以在地毯上走动——这意味着地毯必须耐用。

senses: adj. 有意义的,意味深长的
meaning.usage: meaning 为广义;purport 指长篇陈述的主旨大义;sense 尤指某个词的特殊含义

ex.en: The poem's meaning becomes clearer only when read against its historical background.
ex.zh: 只有结合历史背景来读，这首诗的含义才会更清晰。

senses: adj. 富有意义的,意味深长的;有用的,有意义的
adj. 有意义的；易于理解的

ex.en: If we are serious about ensuring that our science is both meaningful and reproducible, we must ensure that our institutions encourage that kind of science.
ex.zh: 如果我们真想确保我们的科学既有意义又可再现，我们就必须保证我们的制度鼓励那种科学。

senses: adv. 有意义地；有意图地

ex.en: The survey was redesigned so that patients could participate more meaningfully in decisions about their care.
ex.zh: 这项调查经过重新设计，使患者能够更有意义地参与关于自身医疗护理的决策。

senses: adj. 无意义的,无目的的
adj. 无价值的；不重要的

ex.en: Without clear goals, daily routines can feel meaningless and exhausting.
ex.zh: 没有清晰的目标，日常生活会显得毫无意义且令人疲惫。

senses: n. 方法，方式；财富，钱财

ex.en: The state is in control of the means of production.
ex.zh: 国家控制着生产资料。

ex.en: And it's a reminder that the EPA's involvement in the Chesapeake Bay Program has long been crucial as the means to transcend the influence of deep-pocketed special interests in neighboring states.
ex.zh: 并且，它（指这一裁决）提醒人们，长期以来，环保局参与切萨皮克湾项目一直是超越邻近各州财大气粗的特殊利益团体影响的重要手段。

ex.en: For many students from poor families, a scholarship is the only means of affording higher education.
ex.zh: 对许多贫困家庭的学生来说，奖学金是负担高等教育的唯一途径。

senses: ad. 在此期间，与此同时
meantime.usage: mean（中间的）+time（一段时间）→在中间的这段时间→在此期间

ex.en: The new policy will take effect next year; in the meantime, the old rules apply.
ex.zh: 新政策将于明年生效；在此期间仍适用旧规定。

meanwhile.usage: adv.与此同时 n.其间，其时

ex.en: The trial is expected to last months; meanwhile, the accused remains in custody.
ex.zh: 庭审预计将持续数月；在此期间，被告仍被羁押。

ex.en: House prices keep rising; meanwhile, wages have barely moved.
ex.zh: 房价不断上涨；与此同时，工资几乎没有变化。

ex.en: She left for the meeting; meanwhile, her colleague answered the phones.
ex.zh: 她去开会了；这期间由她的同事接听电话。

measurable.usage: adj.显著的，明显的；可测量 的；adj.显著的，有明显影响的；可 测量的；索引p412

ex.en: The training programme produced measurable improvements in employee performance.
ex.zh: 培训计划使员工绩效取得了可测量的提升。

ex.en: There has been no measurable change in air quality since the new rules.
ex.zh: 自新规实施以来，空气质量没有出现可测量的变化。

ex.en: Scientists need measurable data before they can confirm the theory.
ex.zh: 科学家需要可测量的数据才能证实这一理论。

measure.usage: n.措施，办法 v.测量；估量，判定；索引p412

ex.en: This should form part of a wider package of measures to address the long-running problems on Britain's railways.
ex.zh: 这应该成为解决英国铁路“顽疾”的一揽子措施的一部分。

ex.en: Economists use various indicators to measure the health of a country's economy.
ex.zh: 经济学家使用各种指标来衡量一国经济的健康状况。

ex.en: The government introduced strict measures to curb the emission of greenhouse gases.
ex.zh: 政府出台了严格的措施以遏制温室气体排放。

ex.en: Precise measurement of temperature and pressure is essential to the experiment's success.
ex.zh: 对温度和压力的精确测量对实验的成功至关重要。

ex.en: Cutting down on red meat is widely advised as part of a healthier diet.
ex.zh: 人们普遍建议少吃红肉，作为更健康饮食的一部分。

ex.en: The root mechan, meaning machine or device, lies behind words such as mechanism and mechanics.
ex.zh: 词根 mechan 意为“机械、装置”，mechanism 和 mechanics 等词都源于此。

ex.en: The mechanic fixed the engine in less than an hour.
ex.zh: 机修工不到一小时就修好了发动机。

ex.en: A qualified mechanic checked the brakes before we set off.
ex.zh: 出发前，一位合格的技工检查了刹车。

ex.en: His father worked as a car mechanic for thirty years.
ex.zh: 他父亲当了三十年汽车修理工。

senses: adj. 机械的,机械似的,呆板的
mechanical.usage: adj.机械的；机械般的；机械学 的；索引p412

ex.en: The failure of a single mechanical component brought the entire production line to a halt.
ex.zh: 一个机械部件的故障使整条生产线陷入停顿。

ex.en: Critics complain that the exam encourages mechanical learning rather than independent thinking.
ex.zh: 批评者抱怨这场考试鼓励机械式学习，而非独立思考。

ex.en: Watchmaking demands mechanical precision as well as artistic sensibility.
ex.zh: 制表既需要机械般的精密，也需要艺术感受力。

mechanism.usage: n.机械装置；途径，方法；机制；索引p412

ex.en: Scientists are still trying to explain the mechanism behind this unexpected biological process.
ex.zh: 科学家仍在设法解释这一意外生物过程背后的机制。

ex.en: The clock's mechanism has to be cleaned regularly if it is to keep accurate time.
ex.zh: 这台钟的机械装置若要走得准，就必须定期清洁。

ex.en: The new treaty establishes a mechanism for resolving trade disputes between member states.
ex.zh: 新条约建立了一个解决成员国之间贸易争端的机制。

senses: adj. 机械论学说的,机械论的

ex.en: The author rejects a purely mechanistic view of the brain, arguing that chemistry alone cannot explain consciousness.
ex.zh: 作者驳斥了纯粹机械论的大脑观，认为仅靠化学无法解释意识。

ex.en: The mechanization of agriculture in the twentieth century dramatically reduced the demand for farm labour.
ex.zh: 二十世纪农业的机械化大幅降低了对农业劳动力的需求。

ex.en: The mine's owners decided to mechanize the pit after labour costs nearly doubled.
ex.zh: 人工成本几乎翻番后，矿主们决定使矿井实现机械化作业。

ex.en: She won a gold medal at the national chemistry competition last year.
ex.zh: 她在去年的全国化学竞赛中获得了一枚金牌。

senses: v. 干涉;管闲事,干预他人之事;瞎搞,乱弄

ex.en: He warned the committee not to meddle in matters that belonged to the courts.
ex.zh: 他警告委员会不要干预属于法院职权范围的事务。

ex.en: Social media has changed the way political campaigns reach and persuade voters.
ex.zh: 社交媒体改变了政治竞选接触和说服选民的方式。

ex.en: The media play a powerful role in shaping public opinion on environmental issues.
ex.zh: 媒体在塑造公众对环境问题的看法方面发挥着强大作用。

ex.en: Critics argue that the media tend to focus on dramatic events rather than gradual social changes.
ex.zh: 批评者认为，媒体往往关注戏剧性事件，而非渐进的社会变化。

senses: v. 为解决分歧找到(方法),促成(协议)
v. (常用被动态)影响...的发生
mediate.usage: medi（中间）+ate→处于中间→调解。近义：reconcile vt. 调解；同义:negotiate;派生:mediation n.调停,调解,斡旋；索引p412

ex.en: A neutral lawyer was invited to mediate between the two sides.
ex.zh: 一位中立的律师受邀在双方之间进行调解。

ex.en: The United Nations attempted to mediate the conflict before it escalated.
ex.zh: 联合国试图在冲突升级前通过斡旋加以解决。

ex.en: Teachers often mediate disputes among pupils on the playground.
ex.zh: 教师经常在操场上调解学生之间的纠纷。

senses: adj. 医学的,医疗的,医药的
medical.usage: adj.医学的，医疗的 n.体格检查，健康检查；另见词组:medical personnel医务人员;medical treatment医疗；索引p412

ex.en: Regular exercise can reduce the risk of many chronic diseases, medical researchers report.
ex.zh: 医学研究人员报告说，经常锻炼可以降低患许多慢性病的风险。

ex.en: She abandoned a promising career in law to pursue medical research in Africa.
ex.zh: 她放弃了前景光明的法律职业，去非洲从事医学研究。

ex.en: The clinic provides free medical services to families who cannot afford private care.
ex.zh: 这家诊所为负担不起私人医疗的家庭提供免费医疗服务。

senses: vt. 以医学方法处理；从医学角度考虑

ex.en: Some psychologists worry that society increasingly tends to medicalize ordinary sadness and shyness.
ex.zh: 一些心理学家担忧，社会日益倾向于把普通的悲伤和害羞从医学角度处理。

senses: n. 药物治疗,药物处理,药物

ex.en: Doctors warn that stopping the medication suddenly may cause the symptoms to return.
ex.zh: 医生警告说，突然停药可能会使症状复发。

ex.en: Take the medicine three times a day after meals.
ex.zh: 这种药每天服三次，饭后服用。

ex.en: Advances in medicine have raised average life expectancy sharply over the last century.
ex.zh: 医学的进步使上个世纪的平均预期寿命大幅提高。

ex.en: She studied traditional Chinese medicine at a university in Beijing.
ex.zh: 她在北京的一所大学学习中医。

senses: a. 中世纪的（约公元476-1453年）
adj. 中世纪的,仿中世纪的
medieval.usage: medi（中间）+ev（时代）+-al（形容词后缀）→处于古代与近代中间时代的→中世纪的；adj.中世纪的

ex.en: The castle dates from the medieval period and is open to visitors.
ex.zh: 这座城堡建于中世纪，对游客开放。

ex.en: Manuscripts from medieval monasteries preserve much classical learning.
ex.zh: 中世纪修道院的手稿保存了大量古典学问。

ex.en: He described the prison conditions as positively medieval.
ex.zh: 他形容监狱条件极其原始落后。

ex.en: The critic argued that easy access to publishing has flooded the market with mediocrity.
ex.zh: 这位评论家认为，出版的便利使大量平庸之作涌入市场。

senses: n. 深思熟虑,苦思冥想

ex.en: Ten minutes of daily meditation can measurably lower stress levels, studies show.
ex.zh: 研究表明，每天冥想十分钟可以明显降低压力水平。

ex.en: The Mediterranean diet, rich in olive oil and vegetables, is associated with lower rates of heart disease.
ex.zh: 以橄榄油和蔬菜为主的地中海饮食与较低的心脏病发病率相关。

senses: n. 媒介(物),媒体;介质,传导体
n. 手段,工具,方法;adj. 中等的;中号
medium.usage: strike a happy medium 采取折中办法;复数media,mediums；n.媒介，媒体；方法，手段 adj.中等的，中间的，适中的

ex.en: The internet is the modern medium of communication.
ex.zh: 互联网是现代传媒。

ex.en: Television remains a powerful medium for advertising despite the rise of online platforms.
ex.zh: 尽管在线平台兴起，电视仍是一种强大的广告媒介。

ex.en: People of medium height and average looks rarely stand out in a crowd.
ex.zh: 中等身材、相貌平平的人很少在人群中引人注目。

senses: vt.&vi. 相遇；开会；集合；结识
v. 会见,会谈;开会,集会

ex.en: The firm struggled to meet the growing demand for its electric vehicles.
ex.zh: 这家公司难以满足其电动汽车日益增长的需求。

ex.en: The manager called an emergency meeting to discuss the sudden drop in sales.
ex.zh: 经理召开紧急会议，讨论销售额骤降的问题。

senses: n. [C] （尤指古代用于祭祀的）巨石
n. (尤指古代用于祭祀的)巨石

ex.en: Archaeologists believe each megalith at the site was transported from a quarry miles away.
ex.zh: 考古学家认为，遗址中的每块巨石都是从数英里外的采石场运来的。

melody.usage: mel（歌）+ody→唱出来的调子→旋律。族melodic a.旋律的；melodious a.悦耳的

ex.en: The simple melody of the folk song has been passed down for generations.
ex.zh: 这首民歌简单的旋律已经流传了好几代人。

ex.en: Farmers in the region rely on melon sales for a large share of their income.
ex.zh: 该地区的农民很大一部分收入依靠销售甜瓜。

phrases.m: 逐渐融入;渐渐与某物成为一体

melt.usage: 辨析:melt指受热软化失去形状成液体;dissolve指溶于水中;thaw指解冻而成液体或柔软固体；me(我)+l(了)+t(他)→我"融化"了他的内心

ex.en: The snow showed no sign of melting.
ex.zh: 雪没有一点融化的迹象。

ex.en: Global warming is causing Arctic ice to melt faster than scientists predicted.
ex.zh: 全球变暖正导致北极冰层融化得比科学家预测的更快。

ex.en: The chocolate melted quickly in the warm pan.
ex.zh: 巧克力在温热的锅里很快就融化了。

ex.en: All member states must agree before the treaty can take effect.
ex.zh: 该条约生效前必须得到所有成员国的同意。

ex.en: She has been a member of the book club for five years.
ex.zh: 她加入这个读书俱乐部已经五年了。

ex.en: Every member of staff receives safety training on joining the firm.
ex.zh: 每位员工入职时都要接受安全培训。

senses: n. 会员资格,全体成员
n. 会员资格；会员人数
membership.usage: 联想记忆：member(成员)+ship(表关系)→会员资格；索引p412

ex.en: Club membership has doubled since the new gym opened.
ex.zh: 自新健身房开业以来，俱乐部会员人数翻了一番。

ex.en: Membership of the trading bloc gives countries access to a huge single market.
ex.zh: 该贸易集团的成员资格使各国得以进入巨大的统一市场。

ex.en: Membership fees will rise by ten percent next year.
ex.zh: 会员费明年将上涨百分之十。

senses: n. [C] 使人想到死亡的物品（或图符）

ex.en: Renaissance painters often placed a skull in portraits as a memento mori, a reminder of death.
ex.zh: 文艺复兴时期的画家常在肖像画中画上骷髅作为死的象征，提醒人们终有一死。

ex.en: The manager sent a brief memo reminding staff of the new security procedures.
ex.zh: 经理发了一份简短的备忘录，提醒员工注意新的安全规程。

ex.en: According to the internal memorandum, all branches must submit their budgets by Friday.
ex.zh: 根据这份内部备忘录，所有分部必须在周五前提交预算。

ex.en: Her memorable speech at the closing ceremony was quoted in newspapers for weeks afterwards.
ex.zh: 她在闭幕式上令人难忘的演讲在此后数周里被各报竞相引用。

senses: n. 纪念物，纪念碑，纪念馆
memorial.usage: adj.纪念的 n.纪念碑；纪念物

ex.en: A memorial was built to honour the soldiers who died in the war.
ex.zh: 人们建了一座纪念碑来纪念战争中阵亡的士兵。

ex.en: Thousands gathered at the memorial service for the former president.
ex.zh: 数千人参加了前总统的追悼会。

ex.en: The memorial hall preserves photographs and letters from that period.
ex.zh: 纪念馆保存着那个时期的照片和信件。

ex.en: Critics of traditional exams argue that they encourage rote memorization rather than genuine understanding.
ex.zh: 传统考试的批评者认为，这类考试助长死记硬背，而非真正的理解。

ex.en: Actors must memorize dozens of pages of dialogue before the first rehearsal ends.
ex.zh: 演员必须在首次排练结束前记住几十页台词。

ex.en: Young children can memorise new vocabulary remarkably quickly when words are presented in songs.
ex.zh: 以歌曲形式呈现单词时，幼儿记住新词汇的速度快得惊人。

phrases.m: 以纪念某人，为了纪念某人

memory.usage: 辨析：memory 着重于记忆力；recollection 有更强的追想意味，兼指追想起的事情；另 speak from memory 凭记忆讲述；n.记忆力；回忆；索引p412

ex.en: Psychologists have found that sleep plays a vital role in strengthening memory.
ex.zh: 心理学家发现，睡眠对巩固记忆起着至关重要的作用。

ex.en: The old photograph stirred up a memory of her childhood in the countryside.
ex.zh: 这张旧照片唤起了她对乡间童年的回忆。

ex.en: Digital devices have such large memories that users seldom worry about running out of storage.
ex.zh: 数字设备的存储容量很大，用户很少担心存储空间不够。

senses: n. 危险的人（或物）；威胁
menace.usage: threaten 的近义词；近threat n.威胁。menace即可作名词也可作动词；threaten vt.威胁；派生menacingly adv.威胁地,恐吓地

ex.en: Drunk drivers are a menace to everyone else on the road.
ex.zh: 醉酒驾车的司机对路上的其他所有人都是一种威胁。

phrases.m: 培养好习惯;改进生活方式

mend.usage: 辨析:mend将打破/撕碎/用坏的东西修补完整;repair将受损/出故障的修理好;patch补缀,填于裂缝破损处；v.修补；修理；愈合；解决(争 端)

ex.en: He mended the fence before the storm arrived.
ex.zh: 暴风雨来临前，他把篱笆修好了。

ex.en: The two countries are working to mend their strained relations.
ex.zh: 两国正努力修复紧张的关系。

ex.en: She sat by the fire, mending her husband's shirts.
ex.zh: 她坐在火炉旁缝补丈夫的衬衫。

ex.en: The Latin root mens, meaning measurement, gives us words such as dimension and mensuration.
ex.zh: 拉丁词根 mens 意为“测量”，dimension 和 mensuration 等词都由它构成。

senses: 表动作，动词词性；表物、行为，名词词性；表示行为的过程或结果，名词词性

ex.en: The suffix ment turns verbs into nouns, so improve becomes improvement and argue becomes argument.
ex.zh: 后缀 ment 把动词变成名词，例如 improve 变成 improvement，argue 变成 argument。

senses: adj. 精神的，心理的，智力的，脑力的
adj. 思想的，精神的；思考的；智力的
adj. 智力的；精神健康的
mental.usage: adj.精神的，思想的，智力的；ment(与思想有关)+al(形容词后缀)→思想的；索引p412

ex.en: The experience caused her huge amounts of mental suffering.
ex.zh: 那次经历给她带来了巨大的精神痛苦。

ex.en: Regular exercise contributes not only to physical fitness but also to mental health.
ex.zh: 定期锻炼不仅有助于身体健康，也有助于心理健康。

ex.en: The job demands intense mental effort, so workers need frequent breaks to stay focused.
ex.zh: 这份工作需要高强度的脑力投入，因此员工需要经常休息以保持专注。

senses: n. (尤指被视为错误的)心态；思维

ex.en: The report blames a short-term mentality among managers for the industry's chronic underinvestment.
ex.zh: 报告将该行业长期投资不足归咎于管理者中的短期思维。

ex.en: Athletes prepare mentally for competition as carefully as they train physically.
ex.zh: 运动员为比赛所做的心理准备与体能训练一样认真。

mention.usage: v.提到，谈到 n.提及，说起；v./n.提到，说起；v./n.提到，谈到，说起

ex.en: He mentioned the deadline several times during the meeting.
ex.zh: 他在会上好几次提到截止日期。

ex.en: The report makes no mention of the rising costs.
ex.zh: 报告没有提及不断上涨的成本。

ex.en: As mentioned earlier, the data come from two national surveys.
ex.zh: 如前所述，这些数据来自两次全国性调查。

mentor.usage: n.导师，指导者 v.给予指导

ex.en: Each new employee is assigned a mentor for the first year.
ex.zh: 每位新员工第一年都会被指派一位导师。

ex.en: A good mentor listens as much as she advises.
ex.zh: 好的导师提供建议之余也同样善于倾听。

ex.en: Under his mentor's guidance, the young researcher published her first paper.
ex.zh: 在导师的指导下，这位年轻的研究人员发表了自己的第一篇论文。

ex.en: The restaurant updates its menu each season to feature locally grown produce.
ex.zh: 这家餐厅每季更新菜单，以突出本地种植的农产品。

ex.en: The root merc, meaning trade, appears in merchant, commerce and merchandise.
ex.zh: 词根 merc 意为“贸易”，见于 merchant、commerce 和 merchandise 等词。

merchandise.usage: [近] goods n. 商品；commodity n. 商品

ex.en: These tokens can be exchanged for merchandise in any of our stores.
ex.zh: 这些现金券可以兑换我们任何商店里的货品。

ex.en: The band earns most of its income from tour tickets and merchandise.
ex.zh: 这支乐队的收入大部分来自巡演门票和周边商品。

ex.en: Inspectors found that some of the merchandise on sale was counterfeit.
ex.zh: 检查人员发现在售的部分商品是假冒的。

senses: n. 商人；批发商，（尤指）进出口批发商
merchant.usage: [族]merchandise n. 商品；助记:merch(生意)+ant(名词后缀表示人)→生意人→商人；发音类似"摸钱他"→每天摸钱，和钱打交道→商人

ex.en: Venice was once a city of rich merchants.
ex.zh: 威尼斯曾是富商云集的城市。

ex.en: The merchant ships carried silk and spices along the ancient route.
ex.zh: 商船沿着古老的航线运送丝绸和香料。

ex.en: He worked as a wine merchant before entering politics.
ex.zh: 从政之前，他是一名经营酒类的商人。

ex.en: The report criticises the industry mercilessly for ignoring basic safety standards.
ex.zh: 报告毫不留情地批评该行业无视基本安全标准。

ex.en: Old thermometers containing mercury are now banned because the metal is highly toxic.
ex.zh: 含汞的旧温度计如今已被禁用，因为这种金属毒性很强。

senses: n. 仁慈，宽恕；幸运；恩惠
mercy.usage: 发音类似没事→孩子打碎了花瓶，妈妈却说没事→妈妈对孩子很仁慈→仁慈；索引p412

ex.en: In The Prince, he championed cunning, ruthlessness, and boldness, rather than virtue, mercy and justice, as the skills of successful leaders.
ex.zh: 在《君主论》中，他将狡诈、无情和勇敢作为成功领导人的技能，而非美德、仁慈和公正。

ex.en: The judge showed mercy to the young offender because of his difficult family background.
ex.zh: 鉴于这名年轻罪犯艰难的家庭背景，法官对他从宽处置。

ex.en: The refugees begged for mercy, but the soldiers refused to listen.
ex.zh: 难民们乞求宽恕，但士兵们拒绝理会。

senses: adj. 纯粹的;极小的;极不重要的
adj. 仅仅的，只不过；纯粹的
mere.usage: adj.仅仅，只不过；me(我)+re(阿姨)→我阿姨仅仅是个普通人→仅仅的，只不过；索引p412

ex.en: A mere five minutes of delay caused the whole project to fall behind schedule.
ex.zh: 仅仅五分钟的延误就使整个项目落后于计划。

ex.en: He lost the election by a mere two hundred votes.
ex.zh: 他以仅仅两百票之差输掉了选举。

ex.en: The mere thought of speaking in public makes some people extremely anxious.
ex.zh: 仅仅是想到要当众演讲，就让一些人极度焦虑。

merely.usage: 辨析:merely指仅此而已,并非其他;simply指就是这样,强调单一性;only指只有这些、不超过,使用时注意其位置；索引p412

ex.en: Merely expanding the orchestra's repertoire will not be enough.
ex.zh: 仅仅扩大乐团的曲目是不够的。

ex.en: The new regulation does not merely affect large corporations; small businesses feel its impact as well.
ex.zh: 新法规不仅影响大公司，小企业也能感受到它的影响。

ex.en: He is not merely a talented musician but also a skilled organizer of concerts.
ex.zh: 他不只是一位有才华的音乐家，还是一位娴熟的音乐会组织者。

senses: v. 合并,并入,结合,融合

phrases.m: 逐渐消失或变成(另一种事物)

merge.usage: 近combine v.结合；integrate v.使成整体。族merger n.（企业）合并；派生merger合并,归并(尤指两公司)；v.（使）合并，融合；渐渐消失 于，融入；兼并（产权，产业）

ex.en: The two banks will merge next year to cut costs.
ex.zh: 这两家银行明年将合并以削减成本。

ex.en: The small villages merged into a single administrative district.
ex.zh: 这些小村庄合并成了一个行政区。

ex.en: Her research merges economics with environmental science.
ex.zh: 她的研究把经济学与环境科学融合在一起。

ex.en: The world is going through the biggest wave of mergers and acquisitions ever witnessed.
ex.zh: 世界正在经历一场前所未有的巨大的并购浪潮。

senses: n. 长处,优点;价值,功绩
n. 优点；美德；价值；功绩
merit.usage: 反义defect缺点,过错；n.优秀品质，价值；优点，长 处 v.值得，应受；他身上有很多优点(merit)，所以很多女生想要嫁(marry)给他；索引p412

ex.en: Reform has been vigorously opposed, perhaps most egregiously in education, where charter schools, academies and merit pay all faced drawn-out battles.
ex.zh: 改革一直遭到强烈反对，也许在教育业尤为激烈，其中特许学校、专科院校和绩效工资都面临着持久的斗争。

ex.en: The committee judged each proposal strictly on its merit, ignoring the applicants' backgrounds.
ex.zh: 委员会严格根据每份提案本身的优点来评判，而不考虑申请者的背景。

ex.en: The plan has merit, but it also involves considerable financial risks.
ex.zh: 这个计划有其优点，但也涉及相当大的财务风险。

senses: n. 精英领导体制;精英管理的社会

ex.en: Supporters claim the exam system creates a meritocracy in which talent matters more than birth.
ex.zh: 支持者声称，考试制度建立了精英领导体制，在这样的社会中才华比出身更重要。

ex.en: The whole village joined in a merry celebration of the autumn harvest.
ex.zh: 全村人都参加了欢乐的秋收庆祝活动。

senses: n. 混乱，困境；混杂；脏乱(c/u)

ex.en: The kids made a mess in the bathroom.
ex.zh: 孩子们把浴室搞得一塌糊涂。

ex.en: The company's finances were in such a mess that several senior managers resigned.
ex.zh: 公司财务一团糟，以至于几名高级管理人员相继辞职。

ex.en: He messed up the interview by arriving late and giving careless answers.
ex.zh: 他面试搞砸了，因为迟到而且回答漫不经心。

senses: ②启示，要旨，主题思想，寓意(c)
v. (用电脑、手机等)给……发消息

ex.en: The film's central message is that technology should serve humanity, not control it.
ex.zh: 这部电影的核心要旨是技术应当服务于人类，而不是控制人类。

senses: n. 送信者，使者，传令兵(c)

ex.en: In the past, a messenger on horseback might take weeks to deliver official documents.
ex.zh: 过去，骑马的信使送达官方文件可能需要数周时间。

senses: adj. 凌乱的；难以应付的

ex.en: Negotiations over the merger proved far messier than either company had anticipated.
ex.zh: 合并谈判的结果比两家公司预期的要混乱得多。

ex.en: Recycling metal uses far less energy than extracting it from raw ore.
ex.zh: 回收金属所耗的能量远低于从原矿中提炼金属。

ex.en: Advances in metallurgy allowed engineers to build bridges far stronger than those of earlier centuries.
ex.zh: 冶金学的进步使工程师得以建造远比以往几个世纪坚固的桥梁。

metaphor.usage: 助记:meta(变化)+phor(带)→带有变化的意思→隐喻

ex.en: The writer uses the storm as a metaphor for the character's inner conflict.
ex.zh: 作者用暴风雨作为主人公内心冲突的隐喻。

senses: a. 玄学的；形而上学的
adj. 玄学的,形而上学的
adj. 形而上学的；超自然的
metaphysical.usage: 词根记忆：meta(超过)+physical(物质的)→物质之上的学科→形而上学的；索引p412

ex.en: Poetry that explores metaphysical questions still fascinates modern readers.
ex.zh: 探讨形而上问题的诗歌至今仍深深吸引着现代读者。

ex.en: The debate moved from physics into metaphysical speculation.
ex.zh: 这场辩论从物理学转入了形而上学的思辨。

ex.en: Critics dismissed the theory as vague metaphysical talk.
ex.zh: 批评者斥该理论为空洞含糊的形而上学空谈。

ex.en: Meteorologists rely on satellite data to track hurricanes forming over the ocean.
ex.zh: 气象学家依靠卫星数据来追踪在海洋上空形成的飓风。

meter.usage: met（测量）+-er（名词后缀，表物）→测量工具→仪表。美式拼写meter/metre（米）

ex.en: The technician installed a smart meter to record the household's electricity usage hourly.
ex.zh: 技术人员安装了一块智能电表，每小时记录该家庭的用电量。

senses: n. ①方法，办法，措施，方式(c)
method.usage: met(a)-(顺着)+hod(路)→顺着路走→办法；[近] approach, way；索引p412

ex.en: The new teaching method has doubled reading speed in pilot schools.
ex.zh: 新的教学方法使试点学校的阅读速度提高了一倍。

ex.en: There is no simple method for predicting earthquakes.
ex.zh: 目前还没有预测地震的简单方法。

ex.en: Scientists must describe their methods clearly so that others can repeat the experiments.
ex.zh: 科学家必须清楚地描述自己的方法，以便他人能够重复这些实验。

senses: adv. 有方法地；有系统地

ex.en: Detectives methodically examined every room in the house, photographing each piece of potential evidence.
ex.zh: 侦探们有条不紊地检查了屋内每个房间，并逐一拍摄可能的证物。

ex.en: The paper was rejected because its methodology was flawed.
ex.zh: 这篇论文因其方法论存在缺陷而被拒稿。

ex.en: Researchers compared the methodologies used in the two studies.
ex.zh: 研究人员比较了两项研究所采用的方法论。

ex.en: Modern business schools teach research methodology as well as practical skills.
ex.zh: 现代商学院既教授实用技能，也讲授研究方法论。

ex.en: The pool is exactly fifty metres long, meeting the standard for international competition.
ex.zh: 这个泳池恰好五十米长，符合国际比赛标准。

metremeter.usage: 注:metre是英式英语,美式英语拼作meter

ex.en: The poem's regular metre gives it a musical quality that free verse rarely achieves.
ex.zh: 这首诗规整的格律赋予它一种自由体诗歌很少具备的音乐感。

senses: adj. 米制的,公制的,十进制的

ex.en: Britain's gradual shift to the metric system took decades to complete.
ex.zh: 英国向公制单位的逐步过渡花了数十年才完成。

ex.en: He was dazzled by the high buildings of the metropolis.
ex.zh: 大都市的高楼大厦使他眼花缭乱。

senses: adj. 首都的,主要都市的
adj. 大都市的；大都会的

ex.en: The metropolitan area now houses a third of the country's population.
ex.zh: 该大都市区现在居住着全国三分之一的人口。

ex.en: Metropolitan police forces deal with far more cases than rural ones.
ex.zh: 大都市的警察部队处理的案件远多于农村地区的警察部队。

ex.en: She prefers metropolitan life to quiet village routines.
ex.zh: 与宁静的乡村生活相比，她更喜欢大都市的生活。

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

ex.en: Mexico exports a large share of its manufactured goods to its northern neighbour.
ex.zh: 墨西哥将其制成品的很大一部分出口到北方邻国。

ex.en: The prefix micro, meaning small, occurs in microscope, microphone and microeconomics.
ex.zh: 前缀 micro 意为“微、小”，出现在 microscope、microphone 和 microeconomics 等词中。

ex.en: The microbiologist spent years studying bacteria that survive in hot springs at near-boiling temperatures.
ex.zh: 这位微生物学家多年来一直研究在接近沸点的温泉中存活的细菌。

microphone.usage: 助记:音"麦克风"/micro(微小的)+phone(发声的工具)→扩音器

ex.en: The speaker adjusted the microphone so that everyone in the hall could hear clearly.
ex.zh: 演讲者调整了话筒，以便大厅里的每个人都能听清楚。

microscope.usage: 助记:micro(微小的)+scope(看)→能看微小的→显微镜；n.显微镜

ex.en: Under the microscope, the cells appeared perfectly normal.
ex.zh: 在显微镜下，这些细胞看起来完全正常。

ex.en: The laboratory has just bought a powerful new electron microscope.
ex.zh: 实验室刚购置了一台功能强大的新型电子显微镜。

ex.en: Their private lives came under the microscope after the scandal.
ex.zh: 丑闻发生后，他们的私生活受到了细密的审视。

ex.en: Ready meals that can be heated in a microwave now account for a fifth of supermarket food sales.
ex.zh: 可用微波炉加热的即食餐如今占超市食品销售额的五分之一。

ex.en: The market is busiest around midday, when office workers arrive on their lunch breaks.
ex.zh: 市场在正午前后最为繁忙，此时上班族趁着午休前来。

ex.en: The company occupies the middle of the market, between luxury brands and budget options.
ex.zh: 该公司占据市场的中间地带，介于奢侈品牌与平价产品之间。

senses: a. 中产阶级的；古板的

ex.en: Rising housing costs have squeezed many middle-class families out of city centres.
ex.zh: 不断上涨的住房成本把许多中产阶级家庭挤出了市中心。

ex.en: Selling directly to consumers online allows farmers to cut out the middleman and keep more of the profit.
ex.zh: 在网上直接向消费者销售，农民便能省去中间商，保住更多利润。

ex.en: The deadline for submitting applications is strictly midnight on the last day of the month.
ex.zh: 提交申请的截止时间严格限定为当月最后一天的午夜。

midst.usage: in our/your/their midst在我们(你们、他们)当中

ex.en: The country found itself in the midst of an economic crisis it had long feared.
ex.zh: 这个国家发现自己正处于长期担忧的经济危机之中。

senses: modal v. 可能；可以；应该

ex.en: Consumers might respond more positively if the price were slightly lower.
ex.zh: 如果价格稍低一些，消费者的反应可能会更积极。

ex.en: Local businesses have struggled mightily to recover since the flood damaged the main road.
ex.zh: 自洪水损毁主干道以来，当地企业一直在竭力恢复经营。

ex.en: The mighty river carries fertile soil far inland, sustaining agriculture across the whole valley.
ex.zh: 这条磅礴的大河把肥沃的土壤带往遥远的内陆，滋养着整个流域的农业。

senses: v. 移居(尤指移居国外),迁移;迁徙
migrate.usage: 辨析:migrate迁移迁徙;emigrate移居他国成公民;immigrate移居入境;反义stay;派生migratory迁移的；词根:migr(move移动)+ate(做,使)→迁移;辨:(人/动物等)迁徙；索引p412

ex.en: Each autumn, thousands of birds migrate south in search of warmer weather and food.
ex.zh: 每年秋天，成千上万的鸟向南迁徙，以寻找更温暖的天气和食物。

ex.en: Many young people migrate to big cities in the hope of finding better jobs.
ex.zh: 许多年轻人怀揣找到更好工作的希望移居大城市。

ex.en: These fish migrate between fresh water and the sea at different stages of their lives.
ex.zh: 这些鱼在生命的不同阶段在淡水和海洋之间迁徙。

migration.usage: n.移民，迁徙；词根:migr(move移动)+ation(表行为、状态)→移居;n.移居例为2012年翻译；索引p412

ex.en: When people in developing countries worry about migration, they are usually concerned at the prospect of their best and brightest departure to Silicon Valley or to hospitals and universities in the developed world.
ex.zh: 当发展中国家的人们为移民而担忧时，他们通常担忧的是他们国家最优秀、最有前途的人会不会去硅谷或是发达国家的医院和大学发展。

ex.en: The migration of wildebeest across the plains follows the seasonal rains.
ex.zh: 角马横跨平原的大迁徙随着季节性降雨而进行。

ex.en: Rural-to-urban migration has left many villages populated only by the elderly.
ex.zh: 从农村向城市的移民潮使许多村庄只剩下老年人。

senses: adj. 温和的；和善的；不严厉的
mild.usage: 助记:wild的首字母w变成m就是mild(温和的)；发音类似“妹（m）爱（i）的（d）”。女生可能喜欢什么性格的人？→温和的；和善的。

ex.en: That's a mild and detached way.
ex.zh: 那是一种温和且客观的方式。

ex.en: The region enjoys a mild climate, with few extremes of heat or cold.
ex.zh: 该地区气候温和，很少出现酷热或严寒的极端天气。

ex.en: He received only a mild punishment for breaking the rules.
ex.zh: 他因违反规定只受到了轻微的处罚。

senses: adv. 温和地,和善地;略微地;适度地

ex.en: The professor seemed mildly annoyed when students kept glancing at their phones during the lecture.
ex.zh: 讲课时学生们不断瞥看手机，教授显得有些不悦。

ex.en: The nearest hospital is thirty miles away, which worries many rural residents.
ex.zh: 最近的医院在三十英里之外，这让许多农村居民感到担忧。

senses: n. 里程碑;重大事件;重要阶段;转折点
milestone.usage: mile（英里）+stone（石头）→古罗马放在路边标记英里数的石头→里程碑。近landmark n.地标；里程碑；索引p412

ex.en: The vaccine's approval was a milestone in the fight against the disease.
ex.zh: 这种疫苗的获批是抗击该疾病的一个里程碑。

ex.en: The birth of their first grandchild was a joyful family milestone.
ex.zh: 第一个孙辈的出生是这个家庭的一个欢乐里程碑。

ex.en: The discovery of the atom's structure was a milestone of twentieth-century science.
ex.zh: 原子结构的发现是二十世纪科学的一座里程碑。

senses: adj. 好战的，积极从事或支持使用武力的，激进的
militant.usage: milit（战斗）+-ant→战斗性强的→好战的。族militancy n.战斗性；激进

ex.en: The union's more militant members demanded an immediate strike, overruling the leadership.
ex.zh: 工会中较为激进的成员要求立即罢工，否决了领导层的意见。

senses: adv. 好战地,好斗地,强硬地

ex.en: The union militantly defended its members' pension rights throughout the lengthy negotiations.
ex.zh: 在漫长的谈判中，工会态度强硬地捍卫了会员的养老金权利。

senses: adj. 军事的，军用的，军队的
military.usage: adj.军事的，军队的 n.军人，军方；索引p412

ex.en: The government has cut spending on education while increasing the military budget.
ex.zh: 政府削减了教育开支，同时增加了军费预算。

ex.en: The bridge was originally built for military use and later opened to the public.
ex.zh: 这座桥最初为军用而建，后来向公众开放。

ex.en: Many retired military officers take up second careers in politics or business.
ex.zh: 许多退役军官在政界或商界开启第二职业。

ex.en: Doctors recommend that children drink milk daily to build strong bones.
ex.zh: 医生建议儿童每天喝牛奶以强健骨骼。

ex.en: Modern dairies schedule milking with remarkable precision to keep milk output stable.
ex.zh: 现代奶牛场极为精确地安排挤奶时间，以保持产奶量稳定。

mill.usage: 辨析:mill尤用于轻工业如纺织面粉造纸厂;plant多用于电气机械制造业;works多用于钢铁重工业

ex.en: The old textile mill has been converted into apartments and artist studios.
ex.zh: 这座旧纺织厂已被改造成公寓和艺术家工作室。

millennial.usage: adj.一千年的，千禧年的 n.千禧一代 Z 世代：指出生于20 世纪90 年代末和21 世纪初的人群。；索引p412

ex.en: Millennial workers value flexibility more than generous salaries.
ex.zh: 千禧一代的劳动者比起丰厚的薪水更看重灵活性。

ex.en: As a millennial, she has never known a world without the internet.
ex.zh: 作为千禧一代，她从未经历过没有互联网的世界。

ex.en: Millennials are delaying both marriage and the purchase of their first home.
ex.zh: 千禧一代正在推迟结婚和购买首套房。

senses: n. 千年,(未来的)太平盛世

phrases.p: by the turn of the millennium

ex.en: The castle has stood beside the lake for almost a millennium.
ex.zh: 这座城堡在湖边矗立了将近一千年。

ex.en: The bridge is expected to serve the city for a full millennium.
ex.zh: 这座大桥预计将整整一千年为这座城市服务。

ex.en: Scientists note that a cold period lasting half a millennium once reshaped European agriculture.
ex.zh: 科学家指出，一段持续五百年的寒冷期曾重塑了欧洲的农业。

ex.en: The surgeon guided the instrument to within a millimetre of the damaged nerve.
ex.zh: 外科医生将器械引导到距受损神经一毫米以内。

ex.en: Engineers measured the engine parts to the nearest millimetre before assembly.
ex.zh: 工程师在组装前把发动机零件测量精确到毫米。

ex.en: Over a million viewers watched the science documentary on its first night.
ex.zh: 一百多万观众在首播当晚观看了这部科学纪录片。

millionaire.usage: 助记:million(百万)+aire(名词后缀表示人)→百万富翁

ex.en: The self-made millionaire attributes his success to persistence rather than luck.
ex.zh: 这位白手起家的百万富翁把成功归因于坚持而非运气。

ex.en: Some insects mimic the appearance of leaves to avoid being eaten by birds.
ex.zh: 一些昆虫模仿树叶的外形，以避免被鸟类捕食。

ex.en: Participants were given fifteen min to complete the reading comprehension task.
ex.zh: 参与者有十五分钟时间完成阅读理解任务。

senses: n. ①头脑，心智，精神，智慧(c)

ex.en: Keep an open mind when you listen to opposing arguments.
ex.zh: 听取相反意见时要保持开放的心态。

ex.en: Would you mind closing the window? It is rather cold in here.
ex.zh: 请你把窗户关上好吗？这里相当冷。

ex.en: Great discoveries begin in the mind long before they appear in the laboratory.
ex.zh: 伟大的发现在出现在实验室之前，很早就已在头脑中萌芽。

ex.en: Critics warn that mindless scrolling through short videos erodes people's attention spans.
ex.zh: 批评人士警告说，漫无目的地刷短视频会削弱人们的注意力持续时间。

senses: adv. 不用脑子地,不费心思地

ex.en: Students who copy notes mindlessly often fail to grasp the ideas behind them.
ex.zh: 不加思考地抄笔记的学生往往把握不住笔记背后的思想。

senses: n. [C] 思维模式；思想倾向
n. 观念模式;思维倾向

ex.en: A fixed mindset treats failure as proof of limited ability.
ex.zh: 固定型思维模式把失败当作能力有限的证明。

ex.en: Companies need a global mindset to compete in international markets.
ex.zh: 企业需要全球化的思维模式才能在国际市场上竞争。

ex.en: Changing the mindset of consumers is harder than changing their habits.
ex.zh: 改变消费者的思维模式比改变他们的习惯更难。

ex.en: The coal mine closed decades ago, leaving behind polluted soil and water.
ex.zh: 这座煤矿几十年前就关闭了，留下了受污染的土壤和水体。

ex.en: The rescued miner described the weeks spent underground in near-total darkness.
ex.zh: 获救矿工讲述了在地下近乎全黑的环境中度过的数周。

ex.en: The region's economy depends heavily on exporting minerals such as copper and iron.
ex.zh: 该地区的经济严重依赖铜和铁等矿物的出口。

senses: vt.&vi. 使混合；（尤指在社交场所）相交往

phrases.m: 与某人/某事物交往或联系

mingle.usage: 近mix v.混合；blend v.融合。mingle强调人与人的交往混杂

ex.en: At the reception, academics mingled freely with journalists and policymakers.
ex.zh: 在招待会上，学者们与记者和政策制定者自由交往。

ex.en: The prefix mini, meaning small, appears in minibus, miniskirt and minicomputer.
ex.zh: 前缀 mini 意为“小”，出现在 minibus、miniskirt 和 minicomputer 等词中。

miniature.usage: 助记:mini(small小的)+ature(名词兼形容词后缀)→缩小的

ex.en: They expect their children to behave like miniature adults.
ex.zh: 他们希望自己的孩子举止像个小大人。

ex.en: The architect built a miniature model of the new stadium.
ex.zh: 建筑师制作了新体育场的微缩模型。

ex.en: He collects miniature portraits painted two centuries ago.
ex.zh: 他收藏绘于两个世纪前的微型画像。

ex.en: The miniaturization of electronic components has made powerful computers portable and affordable.
ex.zh: 电子元件的小型化使功能强大的计算机变得便携且价格可及。

senses: adj. 极小的;极少的;最小的
adj. 极小的；极少的；最小的

ex.en: It is financially terrifying, psychologically embarrassing and you know that support is minimal and extraordinarily hard to get.
ex.zh: 它(指失业)带来的是可怕的经济以及心理上的困窘，你知道(政府的)支持是极少的，并且还极难得到。

senses: n. 极简抽象派艺术家;简约主义者

ex.en: The architect's minimalist design reduces the building to simple lines, plain surfaces and natural light.
ex.zh: 这位建筑师的极简设计把建筑简化为简洁的线条、素净的表面和自然光。

senses: v. 把……减至最低数量（或程度）

ex.en: Doctors advise patients to minimise their intake of salt in order to lower blood pressure.
ex.zh: 医生建议患者尽量减少盐的摄入量以降低血压。
